overall: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating by email, outside a meeting, on a draft and final written decision denying a special permit; the AG ordered compliance and disclosure of the emails, but found no intentional violation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleges the Planning Board filed a 17-page special permit denial decision without a public meeting to approve the written decision.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating outside of a meeting to draft and approve the written decision denying a special permit for the Tolles Parsons Center.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
Disclose at its next regularly scheduled meeting the emails sent between and among a quorum of the Board concerning the Tolles Parsons Center decision
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
